```{r}
#| label: fetch-publications
library(httr2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

orcid     <- "0000-0002-0457-9641"
author_url <- paste0(
  "https://api.openalex.org/authors/orcid:", orcid,
  "?select=id,display_name,works_count"
)
author_resp <- request(author_url) |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json()
author_id   <- author_resp$id

fetch_works <- function(author_id) {
  base_url <- paste0(
    "https://api.openalex.org/works",
    "?filter=authorships.author.id:", author_id,
    # ── added abstract_inverted_index to the select list ──
    "&select=title,publication_year,type,primary_location,authorships,doi,open_access,abstract_inverted_index",
    "&sort=publication_year:desc",
    "&per_page=200"
  )
  resp    <- request(base_url) |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json()
  results <- resp$results
  while (!is.null(resp$meta$next_cursor)) {
    next_url <- paste0(base_url, "&cursor=", resp$meta$next_cursor)
    resp     <- request(next_url) |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json()
    results  <- c(results, resp$results)
  }
  results
}

# ── Reconstruct plain-text abstract from OpenAlex inverted index ──────────────
reconstruct_abstract <- function(inv_index) {
  if (is.null(inv_index) || length(inv_index) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  positions <- unlist(inv_index, recursive = FALSE)
  words     <- rep(names(inv_index), lengths(inv_index))
  idx       <- order(unlist(inv_index))
  paste(words[idx], collapse = " ")
}

works_raw <- fetch_works(author_id)

parse_work <- function(w) {
  title    <- w$title %||% "Untitled"
  year     <- w$publication_year
  doi      <- w$doi
  oa_url   <- w$open_access$oa_url
  landing  <- w$primary_location$landing_page_url
  journal  <- w$primary_location$source$display_name
  type     <- w$type
  abstract <- reconstruct_abstract(w$abstract_inverted_index)   # ← new
  authors  <- map_chr(w$authorships, ~ .x$author$display_name) |>
    paste(collapse = ", ")
  url <- oa_url %||% landing %||%
    if (!is.null(doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", doi) else NA_character_
  tibble(title, year, authors, journal, type, abstract, doi, url)
}

pubs <- map(works_raw, parse_work) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(doi_key = if_else(is.na(doi) | doi == "", title, doi)) |>
  distinct(doi_key, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(-doi_key) |>
  filter(type %in% c(
    "article", "journal-article", "preprint", "book-chapter",
    "proceedings-article", "review", "letter"
  )) |>
  arrange(desc(year))
```

```{r}
#| label: render-publications
#| results: asis

highlight_author <- function(authors_str, name = "Selcan Aydin") {
  str_replace(authors_str, fixed(name), paste0("**", name, "**"))
}

render_pub <- function(row) {
  # ── Title (linked if URL available) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  title_text <- if (!is.na(row$url)) {
    paste0("[", row$title, "](", row$url, ")")
  } else {
    row$title
  }

  authors_fmt  <- highlight_author(row$authors)

  journal_line <- if (!is.na(row$journal) && row$journal != "") {
    paste0("*", row$journal, "*")
  } else {
    paste0("*", str_to_title(str_replace_all(row$type, "-", " ")), "*")
  }

  year_str <- if (!is.na(row$year)) as.character(row$year) else "n.d."

  # ── Abstract blurb (truncated to ~200 chars, like Silvia's style) ────────────
  abstract_block <- if (!is.na(row$abstract) && nchar(row$abstract) > 0) {
    blurb <- if (nchar(row$abstract) > 220) {
      paste0(str_sub(row$abstract, 1, 220), "…")
    } else {
      row$abstract
    }
    paste0("::: {.pub-abstract}\n", blurb, "\n:::\n")
  } else {
    ""
  }

  # ── Badges ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  doi_badge <- if (!is.na(row$doi)) {
    paste0(
      '<a href="https://doi.org/', row$doi,
      '" class="pub-badge pub-badge-doi" target="_blank">DOI</a>'
    )
  } else ""

  oa_badge <- if (!is.na(row$url) && grepl("^http", row$url)) {
    paste0(
      '<a href="', row$url,
      '" class="pub-badge pub-badge-oa" target="_blank">Open Access</a>'
    )
  } else ""

  type_badge <- paste0(
    '<span class="pub-badge pub-badge-type">',
    str_to_title(str_replace_all(row$type, "-", " ")),
    "</span>"
  )

  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.pub-card}\n",
    "::: {.pub-title}\n",    title_text,    "\n:::\n",
    "::: {.pub-authors}\n",  authors_fmt,   "\n:::\n",
    "::: {.pub-meta}\n",     journal_line, " · ", year_str, "\n:::\n",
    abstract_block,                                           # ← new
    "::: {.pub-badges}\n",   type_badge, doi_badge, oa_badge, "\n:::\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}

years <- sort(unique(pubs$year), decreasing = TRUE)
for (yr in years) {
  cat(paste0("## ", yr, " {.pub-year}\n\n"))
  yr_pubs <- filter(pubs, year == yr)
  pwalk(yr_pubs, function(...) render_pub(tibble(...)))
}
```
